title: Preflight
description: Checks your current setup against real, live application state before you go live. This never starts a stream, publishes metadata, or changes anything by itself.
streamingActiveNotice: Pre-stream check unavailable while streaming. Check the Dashboard or History for current stream status instead.
noDestinations: No destinations to check yet - enable a destination or select a setup.

findings.metadataInvalid: Local stream details need attention before publishing
findings.accountReconnectRequired: Connected account needs to be reconnected
findings.setupDestinationMissing: This setup references a deleted destination
findings.setupMetadataPresetMissing: This setup references a deleted metadata preset
